stories.title: Homicide detectives called to Vancouver home after 2 people found dead
stories.summary: Police said homicide detectives were called to the home in the 1000 block of East 52nd Avenue after officers were first called there around 12:45 a.m.

stories.title: Vancouver Island war museum closing as visitors drop — but staff not giving up hope
stories.summary: 'Until about two years ago, we had no idea that we would be in this situation,' Lewis Bartholomew, founder and executive director of the HMCS Alberni museum, told Global News.

stories.title: Chase de Balinhard inquest hears 911 call and how officer comforted teen as he died
stories.summary: On Feb. 9, 2025, Surrey RCMP responded to reports of a person with a weapon near an elementary school near 70 Avenue and 185 Street.

stories.title: Rain hammering B.C. south coast may taper, but more on the way: meteorologist
stories.summary: Drenching rain that has been soaking southern British Columbia for days could ease Wednesday— but the reprieve might be short-lived, with yet another storm system on the way.

stories.title: Crown seeks dangerous offender status for convicted Vancouver sex offender
stories.summary: Gordon James Joseph Leclerc, 75, was originally charged with aggravated sexual assault and sexual assault with a weapon – a cane – between Sept. 7 and Sept. 9, 2021.

stories.title: B.C. remembers: Watch the 2026 Vancouver Remembrance Day ceremony
stories.summary: The ceremony runs from 10 a.m. to 11:30 a.m. and will be live-streamed in this story post and on the Global BC YouTube page.

stories.title: New Surrey City Council sets 16 priorities including the SkyTrain expansion
stories.summary: According to the newly appointed City Council, logistics, timelines, and budgets will be decided in future council meetings, but they assure immediate action.

stories.title: Burnaby RCMP officer prevents accident after inspecting commercial truck
stories.summary: In early October, officers stopped a large commercial truck heading down a steep hill at Oakmount Crescent, which is not a designated truck route.

stories.title: Fatal B.C. attack involved 4 bears displaying ‘predatory behaviour,’ officials say
stories.summary: A GoFundMe page identified the victims as Jenny Balcarras and her daughter, Selah Reed. One person’s remains were found in the Snooka West Trail area last Monday.

stories.title: B.C. deluge could bring 250 mm of rain as search for missing canoeist suspended
stories.summary: A deluge hitting Vancouver Island and other parts of southwest B.C. could bring more than 250 millimetres of rain in some places, as forecasters warn of floods and landslides.
